test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The fifty thousand mark has been crossed by Sensex in the last few days.

options.text: Sensex has crossed the fifty thousand mark in the last few days.
The last few days have crossed the fifty thousand mark in Sensex.
Sensex has been crossed in the last few days by the fifty thousand mark.
The fifty thousand mark has crossed Sensex in the last few days.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Sensex has crossed the fifty thousand mark in the last few days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and in the Present Perfect tense.
 
• The Present Perfect in the passive voice has the following form: Object + has/have + been + past participle (V3) + (by + subject)__
 
• The Present Perfect in the active voice has the following form: __Subject + has/have + past participle (V3) + object__
 __
 
• Passive: *The photo has been clicked by the photographer.*
 
• Active: *The photographer has clicked the photo.*
 
 
 
• Rules of Conversion from Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the Subject into the object.
 
• In case of the Present Perfect tense, 'been' should be used after have/has.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct Active Voice:__ *Sensex has crossed the fifty thousand mark in the last few days.*
